verdict.rationale: ClickUp's documented Public API covers a broad slice of the UI. It can create, update and manage tasks, upload attachments, handle custom fields and task types, filter tasks, and create, update, delete, group and filter views at every hierarchy level. It also covers comments on tasks, Lists and Chat views, and the MCP tools reach time tracking. Nothing documents full UI parity, and many UI products (Whiteboards, Automations, Sprints, Proofing, Docs editing, Chat) have no API coverage in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit API–UI parity commitment, API coverage evidence for whiteboards/automations/sprints/proofing/docs/chat, independent or hands-on corroboration of breadth.
